notes: Self-declared as an open-world RPG in the Blox Fruits mould, with EXP, a level tree, distributable stats and a fruit ability system, so RPG leads; the quest givers and chests scattered across the map are Adventure, named second exactly as the skill's own Blox Fruits case does. The author's answer settles the shape: build one detailed, compact starter island crossable in a minute or two, which is world-open on a single surface and keeps the build on P0 — the rest of the archipelago, and the island-cluster and P4 it would bring, is deferred to the modular structure later. Preset Action RPG fits the real-time click-combo mode and keeps all four of its options, with the shape swapped off world-hub-dungeon because the answer rules out instanced areas for this pass. Deciding without a user: most of this brief is scripting, DataStore and UI work with no layout footprint, the bandit training grounds are the aggro ground set back from the village, and no interiors were requested so nothing pulls in P3.
